title: 1st Horror exploration game
author: lethaldj13
selftext:
Initially i thought ah i just wanna try making backrooms game.

But since im close to moving to tokyo i was inspired by Shinjuku station which was a messy confusing subway hub in tokyo.

Then i thought it would be boring to just be a walking simulator so now i also started writing some lores and stories and establishing some world rules how people get sucked into this anomalous space.

Its a work in progress but basically i create the the level design in sketchup (my work software)

I place tags on the objects so codex would know what to do with it (e.g door, i set codex automatically gives it interactions like opening closing and being a physical operable barrier)

And then i send map data to codex and ask it to use it as asset in unreal engine.

Other things were used like paid tripo subscriptions so i also had codex setup the rigging and the sound.

I thought about getting serious with the production so i might get some voice actors and producer for sound design when i secure some funds.

Any thoughts on this? Its the first time i tried making an actual game altho i understood unreal engine and had something done with it before, it was just big help to have codex around
